text:
anna: Heads up — planning a new 'launchpad' edge GPU node pool in eu-west3 for compact low-latency inference (onboarding POCs). Need quick input on sizing, instance families, and a quota mitigation plan.
bryan: +1. Are we expecting bursty traffic or steady baseline? that drives whether we reserve or rely on spot/ephemeral.
anna: Mostly bursty during customer demos + a steady ~10 qps baseline. Peak bursts can be 200 qps for a few minutes.
maya: For that mix i'd suggest a small reserved baseline (2-3 nodes) + spot bursters. Use smaller instances (a10g-like) for density and a tiny reserved h100 for worst-case latency? cost tradeoffs though.
leo: If this is edge (eu-west3) quota is tight. We should check regional GPU quota first. I can open the cloud quota ticket if we agree SKU list.
infra-bot: Quota reminder: last egress ticket in eu-west3 took 6 business days. Recommend raising before terraform PR.
sam: Can we avoid h100s in launchpad? They add complexity (driver, firmware). Mix a10g+compact h-type only if absolutely needed. Also think about GPU mem — some models need 80GB.
maya: Right. For compact models a10g 24GB is fine. Plan: baseline 3 x a10g (reserved), autoscale spot pool up to 15 nodes of same SKU.
bryan: Autoscaler config: cluster-autoscaler with scale-down delay 10m, max node-provision-time 10m, and a 2-node warm buffer (to avoid cold starts). We should set --balance-similar-node-groups off for heterogeneous pools.
leo: Suggest taints and labels: node.k8s.io/launchpad=true, gpu-type=a10g. Tolerations on demo workloads only. That keeps prod separate.
anna: Good. Also need eviction hedging: set PodPriority for demos higher than background batch, and define preemptible fallback flow.
sam: For spot evictions, add a webhook to gracefully redirect traffic to hosted fallback model for a few seconds; demos can degrade to half-throughput rather than fail.
maya: Network note: the edge pool will consume NAT IPs for egress. eu-west3 subnet has only 16 available ephemeral NAT IPs. If we spin 15 more nodes we might run out. Need NAT gateway plan or shared egress.
leo: I've seen SNAT port exhaustion with many small pods. Suggest using multiple NAT gateways or use Cloud NAT with high port allocation. I'll include that in quota ticket.
infra-bot: ACTION_CREATED: quota request #Q-11234 (eu-west3 GPUs + increased NAT ports). Creator: leo. ETA: 4-7 business days.
anna: Can we prep a temporary workaround: limit ephemeral pod concurrency per node (via kube-resources) and reuse long-lived sidecars to reduce new outbound connections?
sam: Yep. Also use a local cache for model artifacts so startup traffic is low.
bryan: Terraform bits: two node groups — launchpad-reserved (3 min a10g, tainted) and launchpad-burst (spot, max 15, mixed SKUs fallback to a10g/rtx-a5000?). Add nodeAffinity and PodTopologySpread.
maya: Add autoscaler priority: prefer spot group first, then reserved. And set surge buffer of 2 nodes for headroom.
leo: For quota ticket, i'm attaching sample utilization graphs and projected vGPU-hours. Anyone can send past demo traffic logs to include? will speed approvals.
anna: I'll attach last 6 demo days. Also drafting terraform PR (w/ taints/labels/iam roles). assigning: @bryan to review autoscaler flags, @sam to check image caching, @leo to attach quota docs.
sam: I can run a preflight job to simulate 200 qps bursts with 200ms target p95. Will post results in thread when done.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: created branch infra/launchpad-euw3-3512349876; CI started.
bryan: cost estimate rough: reserved 3 x a10g ~ $2.6/hr, spot up to 15 x a10g ~ $12/hr (if fully used). Add NAT gateways ~$0.5/hr. So plan for $15-20/hr peak for launchpad.
maya: Can we set quota mitigation fallback: if provider quota blocked then spin up smaller region eu-west1 with lower perf and geo-replicate demo data? fallback plan documented in runbook.
anna: Good call. I'll add fallback-to-eu-west1 in runbook and include a short note about degraded perf and customer-facing messaging.
leo: Next steps: quota ticket Q-11234 open, terraform PR submitted, preflight load test scheduled by sam. Target: green by EOD next Wednesday.
sam: running preflight tomorrow morning, will tag results.
anna: Thanks all :thumbsup: — assigning owners in the ticket and PR. We'll reconvene if quota stalls.
